name: services/housing/check_in
description: Check an user into dormitory. Only dormitory administrators can perform this action.

arguments.name: assignment_id
arguments.description: The ID of the user's assignment. The user may have multiple assignments (e.g. for different academic terms), that's why we need a specific assignment ID here (instead of just user_id).

arguments.name: dormroom_id
arguments.description: ID of the room person will be checked into

arguments.name: check_in_date
arguments.description:
Check-in date, if not given it defaults to now.

The residence registration period (check-in and planned check-out dates) must be contained within the period defined by the user's assignment.

arguments.name: check_out_date
arguments.description:
Planned check-out date - if not given it defaults to a final day of the assignment period.

The residence registration period (check-in and planned check-out dates) must be contained within the period defined by the user's assignment.

arguments.name: resident_type_id
arguments.description: ID of the resident type - if not given it defaults to the value stored in the assignment (if there is no such value stored in the assignment, an error is raised).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
If a check in is successful, a following dictionary will be returned:

  • success - always true,
  • residence_id - ID of the newly created residence.
